headline: Apple posts a Wireless Radio Verification role spanning digital and RF-modeled subsystems
fact: Apple posted a Wireless Radio Verification Engineer role whose description covers radio digital controllers and Digital+RF subsystems spanning PLL, DAC and ADC data paths, power management, and coexistence. The hiring mandate includes UVM environments, constrained-random tests, coverage and assertions, and digital-plus-mixed-signal co-simulation integrating SystemVerilog behavioral and DMS models.

sources.title: Wireless Radio Verification Engineer
sources.summary: Official Apple posting dated November 17, 2025, describing verification of radio digital controllers and Digital+RF subsystems with UVM, constrained random testing, coverage, assertions, and mixed-signal co-simulation.
